payload.title: farm-service authorizes every resolver by the global role alone, so any tenant member of any module reads farm-private batches, tanks, feeds, water quality and storage, and any global MODULE_MANAGER also reads financeLedger and regulatorySettings
evidence: apps/farm-service/src/app.module.ts:549-554 (RolesGuard is the only role decision; no guard reads a module grant)
libs/backend-common/src/guards/roles.guard.ts:155-171 (RolesGuard matches tenant-wide roles through the hierarchy)
apps/farm-service/src/common/authz/permission-matrix.ts:511 (tanks, like feeds :386, storageInventory :487 and waterQualityMeasurements :529, open to every MODULE_USER)
apps/farm-service/src/common/authz/permission-matrix.ts:391 (financeLedger, like regulatorySettings :465, open to every global MODULE_MANAGER)
apps/gateway-api/src/guards/tenant-isolation.guard.ts:233 (the JWT modules claim is only copied into context, never decided on)
payload.rule_violated: D2: module-private data is reachable only with that module's grant, and Company and other modules never reach it through the UI or the API.
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-08, release R4.
